findings.why: Python .format()/f-string style placeholder — a per-call value will land here. (If this is literal JSON/code content, ignore.)
Jinja/Handlebars template slot — after rendering, the value will differ per call.
${...} template slot (JS template / shell) — value will differ per call.
%-style named placeholder — value will differ per call.
ALL-CAPS angle-bracket placeholder (e.g. <USER_NAME>) — value will differ per call.
[INSERT ...]-style placeholder — value will differ per call.
